hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Each partition segment can be evaluated based on the number of set bits versus zero bits.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Precompute prefix counts of zeros and ones across the binary string.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Transition the minimum partition cost for prefix i using precomputed costs of valid chunks.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minCostPartition(s: str, k: int) -> int:
    n = len(s)
    dp = [float('inf')] * (n + 1)
    dp[0] = 0
    pref1 = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        pref1[i + 1] = pref1[i] + (1 if s[i] == '1' else 0)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(max(0, i - k), i):
            ones = pref1[i] - pref1[j]
            zeros = (i - j) - ones
            cost = abs(ones - zeros)
            dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[j] + cost)
    return dp[n]
```

complexity.notes: Computes optimal partition with segments up to size k in O(n * k) steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all 2^(n-1) binary cuts leads to exponential complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains prefix sum and partition cost arrays of length n + 1.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Leverages prefix sums to compute segment imbalance costs in O(1).

    n = len(s)
    dp = [float('inf')] * (n + 1)
    dp[0] = 0
    pref1 = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        pref1[i + 1] = pref1[i] + (1 if s[i] == '1' else 0)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(max(0, i - k), i):
            ones = pref1[i] - pref1[j]
            zeros = (i - j) - ones
            cost = abs(ones - zeros)
            dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[j] + cost)
    return dp[n]
